market.rules_primary: If the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for Silver on Nov 19, 2026 at 5:30 AM EST is at least the close price of the 1-minute Pyth SILVER candlestick at 5:15 AM EST on November 19, 2026 USD/t.oz, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary: The settlement value is rounded to the nearest 3 decimal places. When confirming the settlement value, note the close price for the 1-minute candlestick at a given time is the price at the end of the immediately preceding one-minute interval. For example, the candlestick timestamped 4:59 PM reflects trading during 4:59:00 PM to 4:59:59 PM and closes at 5:00:00 PM. If no data is published by the specified source agency for the specified time, then the most recently available published data will be used to resolve the market.
